label: A24BC2_hP27_191_jmn_b_c-001
title: Predicted LaSc$_{2}$H$_{24}$ Superconducting Structure
comments:
(He, 2024) predicted this structure to be a stable form of LaSc$_{2}$H$_{24}$ at pressures in the range 167-300 GPa with $T_{c}$ above 300K. 
 Later (Song, 2025) found LaSc$_{2}$H$_{24}$ to be superconducting at 298K and above 195 GPa. If confirmed this is the first observed room-temperature superconductor. 
 We use the prediction of the structure from (He, 2024) at 300 GPa.
